material_news_signals.description: Thirty passers are on the move in Nick Shook's QB rankings, with Dak Prescott entering the top five. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 2 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen can do no wrong following up a four touchdown season debut with a five touchdown showing in week 2 he has an early lead in the mvp race patrick mahomes has proven he s completely back from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season he fired majestic strikes and moved with the full capability that has defined his brand in the win over the colts the fact he s operating in an offense that now has a legitimate running game is an added bonus next gen stats insight via nfl pro mahomes completed 8 of 9 passes for 133 yards and two tds against man coverage in week 1 a contrast to a 2025 campaign in which his 5 0 yards per attempt against man were the second fewest in the nfl and his five ints were tied for second most brock purdy is another early mvp candidate after lighting up the rams and dolphins to start the season posting a league best completion percentage of 80 4 dak prescott got back on track in week 2 dropping an absurd amount of gorgeous dimes on ceedee lamb in a 37 20 romp over washington and reminding the football world of his elite talents yes i called him elite and i m not exaggerating matthew stafford returned to form after looking rusty in his 2026 debut torching the giants by leaning heavily on davante adams jared goff was excellent in the second half of detroit s week 2 loss a reality that will be lost on most who only check final scores for the lions sake hopefully his efforts will produce more wins going forward next gen stats insight via nfl pro goff has the most games with 2 passing touchdowns and zero interceptions in the nfl since the start of 2024 18 2023 25 2022 31 and 2021 35 the year he was traded to the lions tier 2 the bengals were a bit uneven offensively against houston s top tier defense but they won with big plays made possible by joe burrow s arm talent decision making and willingness to let it rip while under duress he and the bengals haven t been consistently explosive through two weeks but burrow deserves credit for going into houston and leading cincinnati to a 14 point win next gen stats insight via nfl pro burrow completed all three of his deep passes 20 air yards to ja marr chase for 73 yards and two tds in week 2 against the texans it was jarring to watch baltimore s offense lose its juice once derrick henry disappeared from the game plan in week 2 and it didn t reflect well on lamar jackson yes he didn t have wr1 zay flowers available but jackson s inability to overcome a surprising change in defensive strategy new orleans decreased its blitz rate in the second half and improved and his game sealing interception dealt a blow to his sparkling reputation for at least one week next gen stats insight via nfl pro jackson used play action on 34 2 of dropbacks against the saints completing 6 of his 10 play action attempts for 101 yards bryce young stacked another excellent showing on top of his season debut making throws that wowed viewers and buoyed his standing in the qb index the confidence and conviction represents a significant step forward for a quarterback who needs a career year ahead of contract talks trevor lawrence was incredibly sharp early in denver fitting passes into tight windows and pushing the jaguars offense forward his dropoff in the second half was disappointing though and contributed directly to jacksonville s defeat tier 3 tyler shough has an obvious clutch gene and unchecked bravery that has already propelled two second half comebacks this season and powered the saints to one of the biggest upsets of week 2 it sure helps that chris olave is blossoming a product of a symbiotic relationship between quarterback and receiver next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers drew lock lit up arizona in his first start in place of the injured sam darnold throwing without fear and reaping the benefits he steadied the seahawks offense in a situation that could have taken a downward turn with a lesser quarterback next gen stats insight via nfl pro lock completed 7 of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns jalen hurts tossed a couple of interceptions against the titans but he also pushed the eagles to victory with his late game heroics with a j brown no longer in the mix in philly hurts rapport with devonta smith is among the most enjoyable developments of the early portion of 2026 c j stroud has played well at times in the first two weeks but he hasn t yet strung together a complete performance next gen stats insight via nfl pro through two weeks stroud leads the league in dropbacks 104 and pass attempts 93 only 10 8 of his pass attempts have been thrown at or behind the line of scrimmage the second lowest rate in the league jayden daniels played really well in the first half of washington s week 2 loss and likely would have kept the game close to the very end had he not suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the second quarter it s a massively disappointing development for both the commanders and fans of electrifying quarterback play brian flores vikings defense got after caleb williams whose fast and loose playing style burned him when he attempted an off balance throw on the run that resulted in an interception williams still had his moments but he couldn t overcome the elements or minnesota s aggression and his hamstring injury was an awful way to end his day we ll all hope williams can return near full strength before long because he s so fun to watch tier 4 jordan love was thrown into the rain at metlife stadium in week 2 and unsurprisingly he struggled he did manage to lead a comeback victory with an offense that lacks any semblance of a running game though he ll need to improve before long or else he ll continue to hover around the dalton line daniel jones did his best to keep the colts in a thrilling sunday night contest and nearly threw them to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro jones used play action on 51 5 of his dropbacks vs the chiefs his second highest rate in a game in his career and was effective when doing so completing 14 of his 16 attempts for 159 yards and a touchdown his second most yards on play action passes in a game in his career kirk cousins has been tremendously fun to watch especially for fans of grizzled veterans who might be getting their final chance to play meaningful football before father time arrives cousins play against the chargers was heroic at times and he s done a great job of quieting the conversation regarding rookie fernando mendoza s eventual rise to the top job next gen stats insight via nfl pro cousins joined tom brady 2021 2015 and peyton manning 2014 as the only quarterbacks age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes in each of his team s first two games of a season drake maye played better against the steelers than the 20 3 final score suggested but the patriots have a problem with finishing drives maye still isn t close to the elite quarterback he was in 2025 tier 5 justin herbert isn t the main reason the chargers are 0 2 he s made plenty of excellent throws but he also isn t helping los angeles in key moments when taking unnecessary risks that result in turnovers next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert has gone 0 for 7 with two ints on tight window throws this season less than one yard of separation while attempting those throws at a 13 0 clip a mark just below the nfl average 14 3 geno smith s solid start carried over into week 2 for a portion of the contest but the weather didn t help his efforts in a disappointing loss bo nix and the broncos still have a problem with starting slowly and nix continues to vacillate between a quarterback who can make incredible throws and commit maddening mistakes next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix completed 16 of 17 passes against four or fewer rushers for 205 yards and a td in week 2 against the jaguars tied for the second highest completion percentage when not facing the blitz by any quarterback since the start of last season min 10 attempts jaxson dart s encouraging start to 2026 was interrupted by a knee injury that wiped out the rest of his season throwing the giants into a depressing and familiar scenario from which they thought they d graduated tier 6 cam ward and the titans were much better offensively in week 2 they gave the eagles a four quarter battle most didn t expect to see ward appears to be gaining confidence in brian daboll s offense and has regained some of his playmaking ability that drove optimism after his rookie season although there s still plenty of room to grow it was nice to see deshaun watson produce competent play on a sunday it wasn t great by any means nor was it pretty but watson keyed a second half comeback that saw the browns outscore the buccaneers 17 3 to finish the game including a 55 yard catch and run touchdown for rookie denzel boston his second in as many weeks and a third down completion to tight end blake whiteheart for the game winning score that s exponentially better than anything i ve written about watson in about two years which is worthy of a bump next gen stats insight via nfl pro watson is the first starting qb to lead a fourth quarter comeback to snap a 6 game personal losing streak since justin fields 2025 jacoby brissett played better against the seahawks than his stat line suggested in the first half by leaning heavily on trey mcbride for two quarters it appeared as if brissett might go toe to toe with drew lock that optimism faded in a lopsided second half in which brissett couldn t overcome the suffocating seattle defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett was under pressure on 41 9 of dropbacks in week 2 against the seahawks completing 4 of 11 passes for 9 yards with an int under pressure and 13 of 17 for 86 yards and a td from a clean pocket we have real reason to be concerned about tampa bay s offense a scheme in which baker mayfield simply appears uncomfortable and uncertain i m not sure there s a quick fix to this issue either a frantic skittish mayfield isn t going to be capable of overcoming an offense that lacks identity rhythm and confidence tier 7 malik willis is trying his best to lead an offense that simply doesn t take care of the details and carries one of the lowest ceilings in the nfl it s not necessarily his fault but it s clear he s not quite the quarterback who can carry an undermanned team to victory at this stage in his career aaron rodgers age was painfully obvious in new england on sunday his offensive line struggled to protect him his receivers didn t help him and he didn t look like he enjoyed his job very much somehow an offense with more freedom to be aggressive has produced worse results and at 42 years old it looks like rodgers isn t capable of overcoming these challenges right now next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers finished with 187 passing yards 0 touchdowns and 1 int his fifth straight start with one passing td or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career carson wentz s performance was entirely forgettable in a rainy 9 3 victory in chicago we ll see if kyler murray s return can get the offense back on track cooper rush has been the worst quarterback in the nfl through two weeks but thankfully michael penix is returning to the lineup this week we ll see if his style of play fits better than that of rush who wasn t helped much by an underperforming offensive line

material_news_signals.headline: The Patriots have started strong on defense. What's sustainable, and what isn't?
material_news_signals.body_text: foxborough mass while the start of the season has left plenty of questions for the new england patriots offense it has been an impressive and somewhat surprising start for the defense that side of the ball was expected to be solid but clearly behind the offense instead new england 39 s defense carried the team through the first two weeks against the seahawks and steelers it ranks first in points allowed per drive third in defensive epa per play fourth in yards per play allowed 4 5 and seventh in defensive success rate as more difficult matchups loom starting with the jacksonville jaguars on sunday let 39 s look at what is real in the defense 39 s success and what might be benefiting from the small sample size or weaker opponents which seattle became once drew lock replaced the injured sam darnold what seems real the blitz rate the patriots figured out how they want to play defense at least with the way they 39 re constructed under zak kuhr in the second half of last season in the first half of last season through week 8 they ranked 21st in the league in blitz rate from week 9 on they blitzed at the fifth highest rate in the nfl that has continued into this season some of that is because the patriots still don 39 t have a front four that allows them to consistently get pressure otherwise but some of it too seems to be the way kuhr calls a game it 39 s only two weeks but the patriots rank fourth in blitz rate this season sending at least one extra rusher 42 5 percent of the time per trumedia the league average blitz rate is 30 percent though no team is remotely close to the minnesota vikings and former patriots assistant brian flores calling blitzes on 76 percent of opponent dropbacks there will be plenty more to learn about this patriots defense going forward but it seems safe to say it 39 ll continue to lean on the blitz christian barmore 39 s resurgence barmore 39 s strong start is not a fluke he has a win rate of 20 9 percent per pro football focus the third best in the league among interior defensive linemen after a couple of down years when his production waned he had two sacks in 17 games last season and his role diminished the 27 year old barmore looks like he 39 s back if things continue to go well he could again be a top 10 pass rusher from the interior of the line which would make a huge difference for this unit the linebacker play christian elliss and robert spillane are off to strong starts but the patriots don 39 t have much linebacker depth behind them so it 39 ll be important that they stay healthy they complement each other well with spillane the better run stuffer and elliss the more athletic backer who can run in coverage 34 their communication level 39 s really good with everybody making sure that everybody 39 s in the right call no matter what we need to do 34 coach mike vrabel said 34 they were both very active sunday and that was really good to see we have to have great efforts from those guys 34 what may not be real this level of pass defense the secondary is supposed to be one of the patriots 39 biggest strengths so perhaps it shouldn 39 t be much of a surprise that they rank second in the nfl in epa per dropback but it 39 s fair to expect some regression here the patriots faced drew lock in the opener they played 42 year old aaron rodgers this past weekend now come the real challenges trevor lawrence and the jags on sunday josh allen and the buffalo bills after that if the patriots are still a top five pass defense after week 4 that 39 ll be a success but with carlton davis and craig woodson injured i 39 m skeptical run defense one area where this defense hasn 39 t shined is against the run kuhr 39 s unit ranks 15th in rushing epa per play and what makes that more concerning is that neither the seahawks nor the steelers rank in the top half of the league in rushing epa per play the jaguars seventh and bills fourth boast top 10 running games in that statistic the patriots haven 39 t yet figured out how to stop the run while playing with their preferred lighter personnel groupings that allow either marcus jones or a third safety on the field and that could get exposed over the next two weeks pass rush success this is where things get interesting and it 39 s hard to know what to make of it on the one hand kuhr is building up an impressive body of work dating back to last season 39 s playoffs for designing effective blitzes and knowing when to call them but on the other some of the numbers behind the patriots 39 pass rush success don 39 t look sustainable among players with at least 25 pass rush snaps elijah ponder 12 2 percent ranks 69th in pressure rate and gabe jacas 9 5 is 104th the bright spot has been dre 39 mont jones who ranks eighth in that stat with a pressure rate of 21 2 but that seems unlikely to continue considering jones 39 career high mark is 12 9 and he 39 s now dealing with a shoulder injury that could linger still if kuhr can keep timing up effective blitzes and barmore continues to play at a high level that might be enough to make up for middling pressure rates from the team 39 s edge rushers this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.headline: What the viral video missed about Jayden Daniels' injury and his Commanders teammates' reaction
material_news_signals.body_text: ashburn va the video seems jarring washington commanders quarterback jayden daniels trying to get off the field in obvious pain after dislocating his left elbow before crumpling to the ground as medical staffers arrive to help nearly all of daniels 39 offensive teammates walk off the field cast it against the new york giants 39 reaction to quarterback jaxson dart 39 s injury players kneeling with their heads bowed obviously distressed and it might seem that one nfc east team cares about its star while the other does not could that possibly be the case 34 it 39 s just the opposite in fact 34 commanders coach dan quinn said wednesday 34 these guys were absolutely gutted 34 importantly daniels 39 injury came on the final play of the first half nfl halftimes are timed to the second 13 minutes the video circulating online shows tight end ben sinnott and guard sam cosmi among others walking slowly away from daniels even as backup quarterback marcus mariota leaves the sideline to be by daniels 39 side 34 when the half is over the referees are saying 39 man i can 39 t delay the half they can 39 t stay on the field 34 quinn said the players 34 were like 39 no we want to stay 39 34 so it 39 s just the opposite of that they were gutted they love this guy so halftime was hard and emotional in that space 34 the clip shown on the fox broadcast missed several aspects of what transpired washington players said wednesday for starters quinn followed the official 39 s instructions and told players to get back to the locker room 34 he told most of them to go in the locker room 34 left tackle brandon coleman said 34 but i mean it 39 s tough to go in the locker room and just do that when you see something like that 34 indeed players said they first went to the bench before returning to check on daniels 34 it was a weird situation 34 sinnott said 34 people are trying to figure out what 39 s going on like you want to give the trainers their space to do it you don 39 t want to crowd the guy 34 in the locker room after the game at at amp t stadium players were clearly distraught 34 i know we had to get back in the locker room to try to make our adjustments 34 receiver terry mclaurin said 34 but like i feel like nobody really wanted to leave the field because that 39 s our brother 34 mariota said after the game he felt compelled to go to daniels 39 side despite the referees 39 wishes 34 just praying holding his hand saying that 39 i 39 m here with you man 39 34 mariota said 34 39 you 39 re not going through this alone 39 34 which is what the video seemed to indicate inaccurately as it turns out 34 i 39 m not really sure what the league did 34 center nick allegretti said in the locker room sunday 34 i don 39 t know if they gave us an extra couple of minutes it looked like the halftime clock didn 39 t start for a while which was kind of appreciated because that was that 39 s hard 133 you don 39 t want to leave the field 34 the idea that the commanders were abandoning their fallen quarterback had certainly reached the locker room by wednesday allegretti was frustrated enough that he declined comment 34 it 39 s bulls what people are saying 34 coleman said 34 jay 39 s our guy he 39 s been our guy there was no malice behind that my thought process was 39 the medical staff has got to go 39 i saw the injury happen i saw what happened and i just wanted to give them space to do what they have to do it 39 s no good for 30 guys to stand right there looking over when they 39 re trying to get an elbow back in 34 34 i don 39 t really have a comment on what people are saying 34 sinnott added 34 but as far as the love we have and the brotherhood we have for jayden it 39 s really strong we 39 ve seen how hard he 39 s worked 133 such a tough last year you grow through that adversity you become closer so a lot of that stuff 39 s just nonsense 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.headline: Giants' Jameis Winston returns to starting QB role after Jaxson Dart injury: 'This is what I dream of'
material_news_signals.description: The New York Giants are now Jameis Winston’s team. After being called into emergency action on Monday night in Los Angeles, Winston has a game to prepare for.
material_news_signals.body_text: the new york giants are now jameis winston s team it s a product of unfortunate circumstances usual starter jaxson dart suffered a knee injury that will require surgery but there s little time to waste on acknowledging misfortune after being called into emergency action on monday night in los angeles winston has a game to prepare for this is what i ve always dreamed of to be a starting quarterback winston told reporters wednesday ahead of new york s week 3 matchup with tennessee obviously my respects and gratitude is just going to be with jaxson but at the same time this is what i dream of i dream of being what i am right now and executing at a high level winston certainly didn t execute at a high level when he replaced the injured dart on monday night completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception in the 28 6 defeat he s been here before though starting in place of dart for two games last season that both ended in one score losses winston s experience and performance in spot starts convinced the giants to reward him with a two year 13 million extension earlier in september securing a veteran backup they can trust they just didn t expect to have to turn to him so quickly that s life in the nfl as a backup quarterback though and after being one play away from seeing the field winston can count on it for the rest of the regular season it s truly a privilege he said i had this privilege for two games last year it truly was an honor but for this game alone my focus is on being my very best going out there and having elite fundamentals and precise execution and that s what it starts with and it s as simple as that no matter how big it may seem being present and focused on doing all that you can do with what you have with where you are for right now that s keeping jaxson s spirits uplifted and going out there on that football field and being the new york football giants starting quarterback right now winston is a guaranteed manufacturer of fun playing a wild and often reckless style of quarterback with the arm talent and athleticism to produce big plays the former no 1 pick also comes with what is essentially a guarantee to commit crushing mistakes at the worst possible times as the founder of the 30 30 club 30 touchdowns 30 interceptions thrown in a single season winston s unpredictability has defined his career he s liable to throw for 400 yards but he s just as likely to throw three interceptions or a game losing pick six he did all three as a member of the browns in a 2024 loss to denver winston once even called to the heavens for help after throwing an interception returned for a touchdown telling reporters he was praying for the lord to deliver me from pick sixes the giants will want him to be himself but also keep things between the lines it s their best chance of overcoming the loss of dart and proving themselves as a competitive team worthy of new york s support the fans want to see wins winston said it s not about what i m showing them it s about us going out there and winning football games together giving them something to cheer for giving them something to stand behind but right now my heart this is fresh the opportunity is beautiful it s amazing i m grateful for it but at the same time i ve got a brother that i ve got to keep lifted up and i have to prepare for a football game but i ve prepared for many football games and i ve dealt with injury before i ve had an injury that was really bad so balancing the two but keeping a perspective of do what you can with what you have right now where you re at winston and the giants 1 1 host the titans 0 2 on sunday at 1 p m et

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Giants' Jaxson Dart potentially out for season after testing shows worse knee injury
material_news_signals.description: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart could miss the rest of the season after Tuesday testing showed his knee injury is worse than initially feared, NFL Network Insiders Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
material_news_signals.body_text: jaxson dart s 2026 season is in jeopardy the new york giants starting quarterback could potentially miss the rest of the season after testing on tuesday showed his knee injury is worse than initially feared nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported schefter added dart could undergo season ending surgery right now evaluations are ongoing we haven t gotten any final decisions yet giants head coach john harbaugh said on tuesday minutes after the report broke we ve learned a lot more i wouldn t really want to share too much until decisions get made and that takes more than one person it takes everybody involved when we know what direction we re going to have to go we ll announce that but we don t have that yet so i don t want to get out over our skis on that can t really respond to every report that people make got to work on our own timeline here harbaugh was asked specifically about the report dart could miss the rest of the season i don t think i can really comment on any of that right now until we know for sure what s going to transpire he said dart suffered the injury which reportedly was initially believed to be a sprained mcl at the end of the giants first possession in their 28 6 loss to the rams on monday night jameis winston replaced dart completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception dart walked off the field under his own power and was taken into the locker room for further evaluation monday night which initially produced results that were encouraging enough for dart to attempt to re enter the game espn s laura rutledge reported during the broadcast harbaugh echoed the optimistic sentiment afterward telling reporters on monday that it appeared dart avoided the devastating outcome and landed in the neighborhood of an mcl sprain adding new york would know more after a tuesday mri tuesday wasn t as positive and now the giants might have to confront a reality they d hoped to avoid dart s knee injury marks the second instance in which he s been sidelined due to health challenges he missed two games in 2025 due to a concussion and has attracted attention for his fearless style of play which has left him susceptible to more hits than the average quarterback the hit that caused the injury on monday night however occurred with dart under duress in the pocket and had nothing to do with his scrambling aggression unfortunately the outcome is too familiar to the giants who must shift toward preparing winston as their starter for the foreseeable future winston started two games in place of dart in 2025 going 0 2 in one score losses to green bay and detroit new york felt confident enough about winston s capabilities as a veteran backup to reward the 2015 no 1 overall pick with a two year 13 million extension earlier this month locking down a trusted second option behind dart he ll have a chance to prove the giants weren t misguided in their faith when new york hosts the tennessee titans 0 2 on sunday

material_news_signals.headline: Matthew Stafford, Davante Adams dominate Giants in Rams' blowout win
material_news_signals.description: Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford tossed four touchdown passes, including two to receiver Davante Adams, in Los Angeles' blowout Monday night win over the Giants.
material_news_signals.body_text: aaron donald returned to the field on monday night and so did the los angeles rams offense which was absent in week 1 the two felt intertwined in the 28 6 blowout victory over the new york giants at sofi stadium monday marked donald s first game back since he retired after the 2023 season i was so juiced he came running out of the tunnel and i couldn t control myself matthew stafford said of donald s return i was freaking fired up i m sure y all were in there the fans were happy to see him back and we all were too just the human being the player all of it combined what he brings to our team and to our locker room is unmatched and really to the city which i thought was amazing i thought it was a great reception for him tonight well deserved the juiced stafford went out and ripped apart the banged up giants secondary whipping four touchdowns on 22 of 31 passes for 327 yards new york pressured stafford on just 15 2 of his dropbacks the fourth lowest rate he has faced in a game as a ram since 2021 per next gen stats when kept clean he completed 20 of 27 attempts for 302 yards including all four touchdowns and his lone interception which was a heat check deep shot in the second quarter despite not having all pro receiver puka nacua stafford moved the ball at will feeding davante adams the reigning mvp hit adams with 8 passes for 195 yards and two tds the rest of the rams offense combined for 132 receiving yards he s wide receiver one to me he ain t a two head coach sean mcvay said of adams he was special and it showed all night that s what he s consistently done and i m really happy for him i thought he made some great plays but you could see there s a lot of trust that he and matthew have they were able to get a lot of work together this offseason and it s only going to continue to build i was really happy for him he did his thing tonight according to opta stats the most yards by a qb receiver duo 33 or older in a game in nfl history is 289 by steve young and jerry rice on dec 18 1995 stafford and adams came in no 2 on monday with 195 a week after struggling to move the ball consistently against the 49ers in australia the rams moved unimpeded through the big blue defense gobbling up 481 yards and 23 first downs they converted 5 of 9 third downs and went 3 of 3 in the red zone outside of two turnovers in the second quarter l a did whatever it wanted with donald returning the rams d played with a little more fire and rattled backup quarterback jameis winston who was thrust into action after jaxson dart s first drive injury playing a more physical brand of defense than a week ago l a gave up just 182 total yards 11 first downs and two field goals donald noted that the speed of the game didn t feel like too much after two years off the game really wasn t as fast as i thought he said it was more of me calming myself down overrunning stuff or just my feet not being in the ground how they supposed to be not trusting my eyes little stuff like that but playing the game when i held out in 17 18 it was the same way when i came back it took a couple games to get going it s a little different i ain t played in two years so i gotta watch the film see what i did good see what i did wrong and just clean it up in his return donald had three tackles including one for loss and one quarterback pressure on 18 pass rushes tied for his career low per next gen stats after last week s dismal performance against san francisco the rams got back on track at home mcvay even took a shot at himself for the australia material_news_signals.headline: Packers coach Matt LaFleur: 'Butt-whooping' from Falcons was 'humbling'
material_news_signals.description: The Green Bay Packers got bullied by a previously 0-2 Atlanta Falcons squad 35-14 as the Lambeau Field fans rained down boos.
material_news_signals.body_text: green bay is no stranger to dense flurries usually they don t come in september and usually those squalls aren t of the vociferous nature from locals fed up with the football team thursday night packers fans showered their club with boos during an embarrassing 35 14 loss to the atlanta falcons well that was a humbling night coach matt lafleur said via the team s official transcript certainly i don t think anybody is pleased about this and you know we ve got a couple extra days here and everybody s got to take a long hard look at themselves and we ve got to find solutions and just come back ready to work but it certainly was a tough night tough doesn t begin to describe the ugly watch as the packers gave up 27 unanswered points at one point lafleur s offense couldn t move the ball the defense couldn t stop bijan robinson or drake london green bay made a previously 0 2 falcons squad look like the 89 niners it was a butt whooping lafleur noted i m not going to put it on one thing certainly we definitely have to respond better but that was at least three quarters of butt whooping right there atlanta lost 34 3 at home to the carolina panthers on sunday was michael penix worth a 52 point swing the quarterback certainly got kevin stefanski s offense motoring without the clutch crippling miscues from qb3 and qb4 who played in the first two games thursday s tilt however said much more about the packers than the falcons lafleur s squad is a mismanaged game by jets coach aaron glenn from starting 0 3 green bay has lost two of their first three games by 17 points in 2026 it is the first time they have lost multiple games by 17 points in an entire season since 2017 their 21 point loss in week 3 versus the falcons is their largest home loss in primetime since week 5 2004 against steve mcnair and the titans lost 48 27 their 35 point differential in 2026 is their worst through three games since 1988 the defense has struggled to get stops on thursday they missed a trove of tackles and the back end got burned when they stepped up to try to slow robinson more concerning is an offense playing as if it s in quicksand the shuffled offensive line is a mess it can t pass block or open holes the running game is crippling bad with rbs who miss holes rarely break tackles or try to bounce everything outside and jordan love has been an inaccurate disaster whether the pressure has gotten to the qb who entered his fourth year as a starter or he s simply panicking love s play has been dismal through three games love was pressured 23 times 41 8 pressure rate in week 3 against the falcons completing 8 of 21 pass attempts for 71 yards and one interception to start the season love has been pressured on 42 1 of his dropbacks completing just 18 passes under pressure for 47 yards and two interceptions the lack of a rushing attack has been a problem it was a surprise during the offseason that green bay didn t do more to bolster the rb room given josh jacobs legal quandary with the veteran on the commissioner s exempt list that problem has been exacerbated the packers rushed for 17 total yards on 9 carries on thursday the falcons had three runs of at least 16 yards i think we ve got to continue to work with these guys and try to figure out what we do well because right now i don t know what we re doing well offensively lafleur admitted it was obvious to the home fans who booed the packers play relentlessly tight end tucker kraft who suffered several drops took issue with the green bay fanatics voicing their negative opinion that s pretty tough like everyone pictures lambeau field and not boos kraft said via matt schneidman of the athletic i don t picture boos i picture my home stadium that s tough it s pretty disappointing especially for a home opener it s pretty disappointing it s not going to help us win like i don t know what people think that s going to rally us or something like that but that s we re grown men we re mentally strong enough capable enough to get back on the field and play ball but it d probably much easier with the 70 000 people behind us rather than opposing us the loyalty of packers fans is unquestioned if they re booing it s because the product is not up to the level of excellence the organization has established blind support is for sheep the extra few days before the packers take the field again in tampa bay are as pivotal a stretch as lafleur has faced in his tenure in green bay

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks to undergo surgery, miss at least six weeks
material_news_signals.description: Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks has experienced another bump in the road. Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core muscle injury, which will land him on IR.
material_news_signals.body_text: panthers running back jonathon brooks has experienced another bump in the road brooks is expected to undergo surgery on wednesday to repair a core muscle injury which is expected to keep him out at least six weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported per sources the carolina ball carrier was placed on injured reserve on wednesday knocking him out for at least four games panthers coach dave canales said brooks is expected to miss six to eight weeks brooks left early in sunday s win over the atlanta falcons and did not return it s the latest blow for the 2024 second round pick who has dealt with a litany of injuries dating back to college after missing the start of his rookie season while rehabbing a torn acl brooks took just nine carries over three games before tearing the knee ligament again he missed all of 2025 brooks returned this offseason with renewed optimism that he could be the player the panthers envisioned when they selected him with a second round pick in his first two games of the 2026 season he touched the ball 11 times for 73 yards given the buoyancy the coaching staff had when discussing brooks this offseason noting he finally looked like the player they saw on his college film the latest injury is a bummer for the back it s a reminder that getting healthy and staying healthy are two different burdens the hope is that brooks can return healthy later in the season and provide some pop out of the backfield in the meantime chuba hubbard will continue to shoulder the load with veteran aj dillon as the backup the panthers are working out veteran austin ekeler aaron wilson of kprc 2 in houston reported wednesday ekeler 31 played in two games in 2025 before tearing his achilles if healthy ekeler could potentially be a pass catching option alongside bryce young

material_news_signals.description: The San Francisco 49ers have put up 62 points in two blowout wins to open the season and Brock Purdy has yet to be sacked as Kyle Shanahan's offense is rolling.
material_news_signals.body_text: venturing from san francisco to australia and back to the bay it s been a blissful two weeks to start the season for george kittle and the 49ers first was a 27 7 blowout of the rival los angeles rams in the nfl s historic australian debut next was a walloping of the miami dolphins 35 13 for kittle playing in the current 49ers offense is a complete delight i got really lucky kittle said tuesday on the rich eisen show i get to play with trent williams right we got him hall of famer plays like a hall of famer still mike evans hall of famer plays like a hall of famer still and so just when you add guys like that it s just so much fun cause i mean every time we call a play and i know mike has a chance of getting the ball i m like this is so sick brock purdy s throwing the ball to mike evans and i m blocking for him what a dream come true kittle a seven time pro bowler noted that outside of the wide receiver room highlighted by offseason signee evans the 49ers offense is mostly a collection of familiar talent and it s going glowingly thus far i think the biggest thing is that this is essentially like the same offense we ve had for quite a while now said kittle who had four receptions for 80 yards and a touchdown against the dolphins it s the same starting o line as last year it s the same quarterback the same fullback the same running back the same tight ends the wide receiver room has changed a little bit deebo samuel s been a part of it before i think mike evans would work in any offense because of how good he is with purdy off to a sensational start having yet to be sacked and leading the nfl with an 80 4 completion percentage whilst throwing five touchdowns the 49ers are indeed humming kittle stressed a game by game approach and outlook underscoring that their week 3 tilt against the arizona cardinals would be a tough one at the moment however kittle s smiling wide it s a good time to be a 49er the niners are playing well feeling good about ourselves right now he said football s fun isn t it

material_news_signals.headline: Drew Brees says he reached out to Broncos about comeback prior to AFC Championship Game
material_news_signals.description: Hall of Fame QB Drew Brees says he reached out to the Broncos about a potential comeback prior to last season's AFC Championship Game.
material_news_signals.body_text: ahead of last week s tilt between the broncos and chiefs espn reported that the broncos reached out to drew brees prior to last season s afc championship game about a potential return the news caused a kerfuffle in denver with head coach sean payton saying last week that he d never heard of brees comeback consideration during monday s episode of the let s go podcast on siriusxm co host jim gray asked brees how close he was to actually giving it a shot to return well i d say this so my wrist and my shoulder i don t throw with my right side anymore he said i mean i could throw it 10 yards and it s with a lot of pain you know so that s definitely not gonna get the job done now my mind my body everything else feels great but my right wrist right shoulder wouldn t allow it to happen but did i think about it absolutely 1 000 percent i would ve loved to come back and play for the broncos in the afc championship game get my coach and a bunch of the other guys that i know in that organization the penner family to the super bowl would ve loved it the physical inability was one reason brees couldn t make a comeback the other is that he remains on the new orleans saints reserve retired list brees said it was during his pro football hall of fame door knock that he truly thought about the possibility of returning the hof qb noted that he initiated a text to then broncos assistants pete carmichael and joe lombardi here s the story so i get the knock from the hall of fame i get the knock literally on monday january 19 it was the day after the divisional round where the news had come out that bo nix had hurt his foot he was gonna be out brees said so jim porter who s the president of the hall of fame we re there we re having this moment dan fouts is telling me i m in the hall of fame and i look at jim porter and said well i guess this means i can t go back and play for the broncos this week and he goes actually you can do whatever you want he said voting s already been done you re in you can do whatever you want and so i m telling you when i say i like flipped the switch i flipped the switch immediately texted pete carmichael and joe lombardi my oc and quarterback coach with the saints they were with the broncos i said you guys need me this week i said i might be able to be ready and they re like are you serious we ll go down and tell sean right now i said wait let me get up tomorrow let me give this thing a go so i got up the next morning and i gave it a go i had my 13 year old son catching balls for me in the backyard and man it just was not happening with the right side left side inside the 20 i would have been lethal at least could have gotten them in and out of the right plays but no it wasn t going to happen added brees that was the end of it yeah texted them back and said ah look i ll be there for moral support the moral support went for naught on that day the broncos started backup jarrett stidham in nix s stead and lost 10 7 to the patriots in rough weather conditions

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 3: Patrick Mahomes, Dak Prescott, Matthew Stafford heating up
material_news_signals.description: Thirty passers are on the move in Nick Shook's QB rankings, with Dak Prescott entering the top five. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 2 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen can do no wrong following up a four touchdown season debut with a five touchdown showing in week 2 he has an early lead in the mvp race patrick mahomes has proven he s completely back from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season he fired majestic strikes and moved with the full capability that has defined his brand in the win over the colts the fact he s operating in an offense that now has a legitimate running game is an added bonus next gen stats insight via nfl pro mahomes completed 8 of 9 passes for 133 yards and two tds against man coverage in week 1 a contrast to a 2025 campaign in which his 5 0 yards per attempt against man were the second fewest in the nfl and his five ints were tied for second most brock purdy is another early mvp candidate after lighting up the rams and dolphins to start the season posting a league best completion percentage of 80 4 dak prescott got back on track in week 2 dropping an absurd amount of gorgeous dimes on ceedee lamb in a 37 20 romp over washington and reminding the football world of his elite talents yes i called him elite and i m not exaggerating matthew stafford returned to form after looking rusty in his 2026 debut torching the giants by leaning heavily on davante adams jared goff was excellent in the second half of detroit s week 2 loss a reality that will be lost on most who only check final scores for the lions sake hopefully his efforts will produce more wins going forward next gen stats insight via nfl pro goff has the most games with 2 passing touchdowns and zero interceptions in the nfl since the start of 2024 18 2023 25 2022 31 and 2021 35 the year he was traded to the lions tier 2 the bengals were a bit uneven offensively against houston s top tier defense but they won with big plays made possible by joe burrow s arm talent decision making and willingness to let it rip while under duress he and the bengals haven t been consistently explosive through two weeks but burrow deserves credit for going into houston and leading cincinnati to a 14 point win next gen stats insight via nfl pro burrow completed all three of his deep passes 20 air yards to ja marr chase for 73 yards and two tds in week 2 against the texans it was jarring to watch baltimore s offense lose its juice once derrick henry disappeared from the game plan in week 2 and it didn t reflect well on lamar jackson yes he didn t have wr1 zay flowers available but jackson s inability to overcome a surprising change in defensive strategy new orleans decreased its blitz rate in the second half and improved and his game sealing interception dealt a blow to his sparkling reputation for at least one week next gen stats insight via nfl pro jackson used play action on 34 2 of dropbacks against the saints completing 6 of his 10 play action attempts for 101 yards bryce young stacked another excellent showing on top of his season debut making throws that wowed viewers and buoyed his standing in the qb index the confidence and conviction represents a significant step forward for a quarterback who needs a career year ahead of contract talks trevor lawrence was incredibly sharp early in denver fitting passes into tight windows and pushing the jaguars offense forward his dropoff in the second half was disappointing though and contributed directly to jacksonville s defeat tier 3 tyler shough has an obvious clutch gene and unchecked bravery that has already propelled two second half comebacks this season and powered the saints to one of the biggest upsets of week 2 it sure helps that chris olave is blossoming a product of a symbiotic relationship between quarterback and receiver next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers drew lock lit up arizona in his first start in place of the injured sam darnold throwing without fear and reaping the benefits he steadied the seahawks offense in a situation that could have taken a downward turn with a lesser quarterback next gen stats insight via nfl pro lock completed 7 of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns jalen hurts tossed a couple of interceptions against the titans but he also pushed the eagles to victory with his late game heroics with a j brown no longer in the mix in philly hurts rapport with devonta smith is among the most enjoyable developments of the early portion of 2026 c j stroud has played well at times in the first two weeks but he hasn t yet strung together a complete performance next gen stats insight via nfl pro through two weeks stroud leads the league in dropbacks 104 and pass attempts 93 only 10 8 of his pass attempts have been thrown at or behind the line of scrimmage the second lowest rate in the league jayden daniels played really well in the first half of washington s week 2 loss and likely would have kept the game close to the very end had he not suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the second quarter it s a massively disappointing development for both the commanders and fans of electrifying quarterback play brian flores vikings defense got after caleb williams whose fast and loose playing style burned him when he attempted an off balance throw on the run that resulted in an interception williams still had his moments but he couldn t overcome the elements or minnesota s aggression and his hamstring injury was an awful way to end his day we ll all hope williams can return near full strength before long because he s so fun to watch tier 4 jordan love was thrown into the rain at metlife stadium in week 2 and unsurprisingly he struggled he did manage to lead a comeback victory with an offense that lacks any semblance of a running game though he ll need to improve before long or else he ll continue to hover around the dalton line daniel jones did his best to keep the colts in a thrilling sunday night contest and nearly threw them to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro jones used play action on 51 5 of his dropbacks vs the chiefs his second highest rate in a game in his career and was effective when doing so completing 14 of his 16 attempts for 159 yards and a touchdown his second most yards on play action passes in a game in his career kirk cousins has been tremendously fun to watch especially for fans of grizzled veterans who might be getting their final chance to play meaningful football before father time arrives cousins play against the chargers was heroic at times and he s done a great job of quieting the conversation regarding rookie fernando mendoza s eventual rise to the top job next gen stats insight via nfl pro cousins joined tom brady 2021 2015 and peyton manning 2014 as the only quarterbacks age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes in each of his team s first two games of a season drake maye played better against the steelers than the 20 3 final score suggested but the patriots have a problem with finishing drives maye still isn t close to the elite quarterback he was in 2025 tier 5 justin herbert isn t the main reason the chargers are 0 2 he s made plenty of excellent throws but he also isn t helping los angeles in key moments when taking unnecessary risks that result in turnovers next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert has gone 0 for 7 with two ints on tight window throws this season less than one yard of separation while attempting those throws at a 13 0 clip a mark just below the nfl average 14 3 geno smith s solid start carried over into week 2 for a portion of the contest but the weather didn t help his efforts in a disappointing loss bo nix and the broncos still have a problem with starting slowly and nix continues to vacillate between a quarterback who can make incredible throws and commit maddening mistakes next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix completed 16 of 17 passes against four or fewer rushers for 205 yards and a td in week 2 against the jaguars tied for the second highest completion percentage when not facing the blitz by any quarterback since the start of last season min 10 attempts jaxson dart s encouraging start to 2026 was interrupted by a knee injury that wiped out the rest of his season throwing the giants into a depressing and familiar scenario from which they thought they d graduated tier 6 cam ward and the titans were much better offensively in week 2 they gave the eagles a four quarter battle most didn t expect to see ward appears to be gaining confidence in brian daboll s offense and has regained some of his playmaking ability that drove optimism after his rookie season although there s still plenty of room to grow it was nice to see deshaun watson produce competent play on a sunday it wasn t great by any means nor was it pretty but watson keyed a second half comeback that saw the browns outscore the buccaneers 17 3 to finish the game including a 55 yard catch and run touchdown for rookie denzel boston his second in as many weeks and a third down completion to tight end blake whiteheart for the game winning score that s exponentially better than anything i ve written about watson in about two years which is worthy of a bump next gen stats insight via nfl pro watson is the first starting qb to lead a fourth quarter comeback to snap a 6 game personal losing streak since justin fields 2025 jacoby brissett played better against the seahawks than his stat line suggested in the first half by leaning heavily on trey mcbride for two quarters it appeared as if brissett might go toe to toe with drew lock that optimism faded in a lopsided second half in which brissett couldn t overcome the suffocating seattle defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett was under pressure on 41 9 of dropbacks in week 2 against the seahawks completing 4 of 11 passes for 9 yards with an int under pressure and 13 of 17 for 86 yards and a td from a clean pocket we have real reason to be concerned about tampa bay s offense a scheme in which baker mayfield simply appears uncomfortable and uncertain i m not sure there s a quick fix to this issue either a frantic skittish mayfield isn t going to be capable of overcoming an offense that lacks identity rhythm and confidence tier 7 malik willis is trying his best to lead an offense that simply doesn t take care of the details and carries one of the lowest ceilings in the nfl it s not necessarily his fault but it s clear he s not quite the quarterback who can carry an undermanned team to victory at this stage in his career aaron rodgers age was painfully obvious in new england on sunday his offensive line struggled to protect him his receivers didn t help him and he didn t look like he enjoyed his job very much somehow an offense with more freedom to be aggressive has produced worse results and at 42 years old it looks like rodgers isn t capable of overcoming these challenges right now next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers finished with 187 passing yards 0 touchdowns and 1 int his fifth straight start with one passing td or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career carson wentz s performance was entirely forgettable in a rainy 9 3 victory in chicago we ll see if kyler murray s return can get the offense back on track cooper rush has been the worst quarterback in the nfl through two weeks but thankfully michael penix is returning to the lineup this week we ll see if his style of play fits better than that of rush who wasn t helped much by an underperforming offensive line

material_news_signals.headline: Packers coach Matt LaFleur: 'Butt-whooping' from Falcons was 'humbling'
material_news_signals.description: The Green Bay Packers got bullied by a previously 0-2 Atlanta Falcons squad 35-14 as the Lambeau Field fans rained down boos.
material_news_signals.body_text: green bay is no stranger to dense flurries usually they don t come in september and usually those squalls aren t of the vociferous nature from locals fed up with the football team thursday night packers fans showered their club with boos during an embarrassing 35 14 loss to the atlanta falcons well that was a humbling night coach matt lafleur said via the team s official transcript certainly i don t think anybody is pleased about this and you know we ve got a couple extra days here and everybody s got to take a long hard look at themselves and we ve got to find solutions and just come back ready to work but it certainly was a tough night tough doesn t begin to describe the ugly watch as the packers gave up 27 unanswered points at one point lafleur s offense couldn t move the ball the defense couldn t stop bijan robinson or drake london green bay made a previously 0 2 falcons squad look like the 89 niners it was a butt whooping lafleur noted i m not going to put it on one thing certainly we definitely have to respond better but that was at least three quarters of butt whooping right there atlanta lost 34 3 at home to the carolina panthers on sunday was michael penix worth a 52 point swing the quarterback certainly got kevin stefanski s offense motoring without the clutch crippling miscues from qb3 and qb4 who played in the first two games thursday s tilt however said much more about the packers than the falcons lafleur s squad is a mismanaged game by jets coach aaron glenn from starting 0 3 green bay has lost two of their first three games by 17 points in 2026 it is the first time they have lost multiple games by 17 points in an entire season since 2017 their 21 point loss in week 3 versus the falcons is their largest home loss in primetime since week 5 2004 against steve mcnair and the titans lost 48 27 their 35 point differential in 2026 is their worst through three games since 1988 the defense has struggled to get stops on thursday they missed a trove of tackles and the back end got burned when they stepped up to try to slow robinson more concerning is an offense playing as if it s in quicksand the shuffled offensive line is a mess it can t pass block or open holes the running game is crippling bad with rbs who miss holes rarely break tackles or try to bounce everything outside and jordan love has been an inaccurate disaster whether the pressure has gotten to the qb who entered his fourth year as a starter or he s simply panicking love s play has been dismal through three games love was pressured 23 times 41 8 pressure rate in week 3 against the falcons completing 8 of 21 pass attempts for 71 yards and one interception to start the season love has been pressured on 42 1 of his dropbacks completing just 18 passes under pressure for 47 yards and two interceptions the lack of a rushing attack has been a problem it was a surprise during the offseason that green bay didn t do more to bolster the rb room given josh jacobs legal quandary with the veteran on the commissioner s exempt list that problem has been exacerbated the packers rushed for 17 total yards on 9 carries on thursday the falcons had three runs of at least 16 yards i think we ve got to continue to work with these guys and try to figure out what we do well because right now i don t know what we re doing well offensively lafleur admitted it was obvious to the home fans who booed the packers play relentlessly tight end tucker kraft who suffered several drops took issue with the green bay fanatics voicing their negative opinion that s pretty tough like everyone pictures lambeau field and not boos kraft said via matt schneidman of the athletic i don t picture boos i picture my home stadium that s tough it s pretty disappointing especially for a home opener it s pretty disappointing it s not going to help us win like i don t know what people think that s going to rally us or something like that but that s we re grown men we re mentally strong enough capable enough to get back on the field and play ball but it d probably much easier with the 70 000 people behind us rather than opposing us the loyalty of packers fans is unquestioned if they re booing it s because the product is not up to the level of excellence the organization has established blind support is for sheep the extra few days before the packers take the field again in tampa bay are as pivotal a stretch as lafleur has faced in his tenure in green bay

material_news_signals.headline: The Patriots have started strong on defense. What's sustainable, and what isn't?
material_news_signals.body_text: foxborough mass while the start of the season has left plenty of questions for the new england patriots offense it has been an impressive and somewhat surprising start for the defense that side of the ball was expected to be solid but clearly behind the offense instead new england 39 s defense carried the team through the first two weeks against the seahawks and steelers it ranks first in points allowed per drive third in defensive epa per play fourth in yards per play allowed 4 5 and seventh in defensive success rate as more difficult matchups loom starting with the jacksonville jaguars on sunday let 39 s look at what is real in the defense 39 s success and what might be benefiting from the small sample size or weaker opponents which seattle became once drew lock replaced the injured sam darnold what seems real the blitz rate the patriots figured out how they want to play defense at least with the way they 39 re constructed under zak kuhr in the second half of last season in the first half of last season through week 8 they ranked 21st in the league in blitz rate from week 9 on they blitzed at the fifth highest rate in the nfl that has continued into this season some of that is because the patriots still don 39 t have a front four that allows them to consistently get pressure otherwise but some of it too seems to be the way kuhr calls a game it 39 s only two weeks but the patriots rank fourth in blitz rate this season sending at least one extra rusher 42 5 percent of the time per trumedia the league average blitz rate is 30 percent though no team is remotely close to the minnesota vikings and former patriots assistant brian flores calling blitzes on 76 percent of opponent dropbacks there will be plenty more to learn about this patriots defense going forward but it seems safe to say it 39 ll continue to lean on the blitz christian barmore 39 s resurgence barmore 39 s strong start is not a fluke he has a win rate
